purpose: Recommend something as the best choice, or restrict a category.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
N / V dictionary / Vない + に限る
Nothing beats cold barley tea on a hot day.
When you are tired, going to bed early is best.
Participation is limited to people aged eighteen or over.
formation: N / V dictionary / Vない + に限る
restrictions: Recommendation means “nothing beats”; notices may instead restrict eligibility.
mistake: Read context to distinguish a preference from an official restriction.
